name: Financial Modeling Prep
tagline: Stock market and financial statement data API for equities, ETFs, and more.
description: Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) provides REST APIs for stock prices, company financials, ratios, market news, and related market data used in investment research and financial applications.

auth.details: API key via query parameter apikey=YOUR_API_KEY (self-serve signup). Some endpoints may also accept the key in headers — verify current docs.

use_cases: get real-time or delayed stock quote for a ticker
fetch company income statement or balance sheet
list historical daily prices for a symbol
screen stocks by market cap or sector
pull key financial ratios for valuation models
